Let me check the OpenAPI docs and a real endpoint. Also verify whether the frontend can be considered a required component of the installation.

The task: validate the whole installation according to the guide. The guide describes three components: backend, app (AngularMonorepo), cms. The backend is installed and running. App and cms failed due to missing token.

Let me gather more evidence on backend endpoints and on the frontend failure. Let me check whether pnpm install caches exist, lockfile, whether the packages are truly private and required.

Let me probe the API a bit more and test frontend attempt reproduction (without installing — just verify the missing dependency). Actually re-running pnpm install would attempt installation which is prohibited. But I can inspect node_modules structure and lockfiles.

Let me check the app node_modules content and cms.
